taxonomyDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED: Code written and integrated into codebase
taxonomyDefinitions.MEASURED: Empirically evaluated with benchmark metrics recorded in persistent reports
taxonomyDefinitions.QUALIFIED: Passed all strict verification criteria, regression tests, and contractual invariants
taxonomyDefinitions.BLOCKED_OR_NOT_RUN: Execution halted or intentionally skipped due to preconditions not met

R8-01.title: Wrapper Predict Contract, Value Masking & Shape Assertions
R8-01.description: Unified 2-parameter contract for spatial predictor across PolicyAgent, BoundedSearch, and DAgger. Fixed NET_A undefined/null valueTarget and topIndex/bestActionIndex mapping. Added strict shape, finiteness, and non-empty assertions in TS wrappers.

R8-02.title: Evaluation Protocol, Termination Fixes & Telemetry
R8-02.description: Removed false 25-step stagnation truncation. Decoupled turns and atomic steps. Implemented independent PRNG streams for reproducibility. Enforced illegal action and illegal end_turn checks (throwing ENGINE_ERROR). Validated rehire success strictly post-engine.step. Added latency percentiles (p50/p95/max), search node telemetry, and error trajectory output.

R8-03.title: Clean Benchmark Re-evaluation of Existing Checkpoints
R8-03.description: Re-evaluated existing v7 checkpoints across 80 matches on 5 benchmark maps into clean runId agent_upgrade_20260921_v8_clean_01. S00 natural win rate 53.8%, S10 54.5%, SPATIAL_V2 0.0%, HEURISTIC 50.0%. Retracted premature claims of S00 dominance; HeuristicAI retained as production default baseline.
evidence: docs/training/reports/agent_upgrade_20260921_v8_clean_01/v8_clean_benchmark.json (80 matches, 0 engine errors, 0 model load errors)

R8-04.title: Bounded Search, Response Chain & Quotas
R8-04.description: Eliminated deep water bug (terrainId === 2) using getTileTerrainKey. Implemented natural turn handover with opponent move-then-attack response chain. Enforced tactical, heuristic, and neural quotas. Enforced maxDepth and maxNodes budget constraints in search rollouts.
evidence: Search traces verify reachedOpponent, turnHandover, and oppAttackCovered

R8-05.title: Behavioral State Hashing, Split Manifest & Curriculum Postconditions
R8-05.description: Implemented comprehensive getBehavioralStateHash capturing all rules-relevant fields. Decoupled map and gold sampling. Removed 90-step limit. Unified split_manifest across TS and Python. Verified curriculum E (pending recruitment resolution) and G (decisive victory terminal condition).

R8-06.title: Spatial ResNet v2 Scale & Sanity Experiment
R8-06.description: Overfit sanity check verified on 100 samples with finite gradients. Scaled 10k dataset generated (7,706 unique verified states) and trained Spatial ResNet v2 (32ch, 2 blocks, 4 epochs) achieving 52.9% validation accuracy and 0 NaN/null. NET_A trained on exact same split without corruption. Base model checkpoint SHA: 75c7117b286a83578a3876fe9fa479fe6e7305e054562c86bc79fc411be5ea38.

R8-07.title: Two-Seat DAgger Loop & Paired Evaluation
R8-07.description: Ran 6 diagnostic matches across both seats (P0 and P1) detecting 72 failure windows via 3-way counterfactual replay. Replayed 6,886 clean training samples and 820 fixed validation samples with 0 leak. Executed warm-start fine-tuning via --init-checkpoint producing distinct checkpoint SHA: 1e8fe8be57f97c28f544c41e7953eed0ece5cf66b87c9f2bcede654d895cd493. Completed 40-match paired evaluation showing rehire success rate increase from 85.7% to 94.7%.
